name: Rei
source:
Wary and stubborn, Rei is the leader of The Strays and determined to take vengeance on the witch and save her victims… But with the demons of his past clawing away at him, that's easier said than done.

Will you help him overcome his trauma and free the cat realm once and for all?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.catcity]Google Play[/url]]
